title: IRIS visual world
question: The roll assigned The Swiss Programme. Build it, take an alternate, play it straight, or re-roll.

options.label: The Swiss Programme
options.lineage: Müller-Brockmann concert programmes · Swiss International Style
options.thesis: Hierarchy IS the interface: what matters most is simply set biggest, on a strict grid, with one signal red.
options.viewport: Home opens as today's programme sheet: IRIS wordmark + date line across the top; WHAT MATTERS NOW as a full-width headliner block carrying the AI recommendation at display size; beneath it three grid columns — TODAY / PROGRESS / ATTENTION — separated by hairlines, zero cards, zero shadows.

raised.raise: State is a mark, not a hue — done takes a struck cross-rule, deferred gets a folded corner.
Modules fold flat: nav collapses to a compact rail and deploys in place, so future modules slot into the crease without redesign.
One vertical urgency axis — every list reads top=now to bottom=later.
Progress renders as segmented instrument ladders — discrete ticks you count at a glance.

options.risk: Type-only hierarchy must earn its drama or it reads like a wireframe.
options.case: Assigned direction: typographic authority matches IRIS's deterministic truth; grid scales cleanly from desktop command center to mobile programme strip.

options.label: Mission Ops Wall
options.thesis: A dark instrumentation wall where your life runs as mission telemetry and IRIS speaks as CAPCOM.
options.viewport: Full-height ops wall: mission clock and free-time readout up top; center stage GO recommendation panel with START FOCUS lit green; flanking columns stream TODAY / PROGRESS / ATTENTION telemetry.
options.risk: Dark dashboards with neon accents are this category's gravity well — that familiarity is the honest cost.
options.case: Strongest grounded resonance for 'command center'; ranked it first myself.

options.label: Today’s Billing
options.thesis: Your day typeset as tonight's bill: one face, rank carried by size alone, the recommendation as headliner.
options.viewport: Signal-yellow ground; WHAT MATTERS NOW spans the full width at poster scale; tasks cascade down billing order into a justified tail of small names at the foot.
options.risk: Pure poster grammar has no native controls vocabulary — focus timers, filters and forms must be invented inside it.
options.case: Holds identification (size-as-rank is IRIS's thesis literalized) but limits product clarity for dense CRM/analytics work.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Your day strung as a work print: punched task-frames on a perforated rail, rejects hanging on pins below.
options.kept: Its state-as-mark discipline (struck crosses, folded flags) was lifted into The Swiss Programme.

options.label: Miura Sheet
options.thesis: IRIS unfolds from a hand-sized packet into a tessellated crease-grid of modules.
options.kept: Compact-to-deployed module duality became The Swiss Programme's folding navigation.

options.label: Deep Dive
options.thesis: Priority as depth: descend a vertical water column from warm surface tasks to cold abyssal backlog.
options.kept: The single vertical urgency axis now rules every list in The Swiss Programme.

options.label: Deck Fascia
options.thesis: Brushed aluminum fascia, chrome toggles, amber LED ladders — every IRIS function a labeled switch.
options.kept: Segmented instrument ladders became the progress-bar language of The Swiss Programme.

options.label: Phosphor Scene
options.thesis: The whole interface rendered as glyph density on one strict monospace grid.
options.kept: Nothing material — its one-strict-grid discipline was already native to the assigned direction.

canonCard.label: Standard Dashboard
canonCard.thesis: Sidebar, cards, charts — the familiar SaaS layout executed cleanly. Nothing wrong; nothing memorable.
